column1: # The Archipelago tier. Modules that skip themselves when AP is not importable
# are correct locally and a silent hole in CI, so CI asserts they ran.
# When a PR adds an AP-dependent module, it adds its `module` row here.
# #205's option wiring only exists when Archipelago is importable, so the AP
# tier asserts this module ran all of it rather than skipping the option tests.
